title: Retain immutable prototype source and detect package tampering
preconditions: A fresh Saga and an HTML source directory are available.

steps.action: Import the HTML, edit only the original source and reload; finally alter the packaged copy and reload.
steps.expected_result: Source edits leave the stored revision loadable; package tampering produces a digest mismatch.

expected_result: Retain immutable prototype source and detect package tampering.
